'''Mander Zuma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] who served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. He took an [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Toro Irana]], who later [[Death/Legends|died]] during an investigation into [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal circles.

==Biography==
Zuma was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] who had considerable [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. Zuma trained at the Jedi Praxeum on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], becoming a [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archivist]] and a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. He took an apprentice, [[Toro Irana]], who was often frustrated by Zuma's lack of desire for accomplishment and heroism. When Irana [[Death/Legends|died]] under suspicious circumstances on [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], Zuma went to investigate the death.<ref name="Scourge" />

Zuma's path led him to encounter [[Reen Irana]], his Padawan's sister, who was also investigating the death. They soon learned that Irana had been connected to a drug called [[Scourge (drug)|Scourge]].<ref name="Scourge" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Scourge.jpg|thumb|left|Zuma enters the chambers of Popara Anjiliac Diresto.]]
Mander Zuma was more at home in the Jedi Archives than in the field, so his combat skills were rusty, coupled with his own doubts of whether he could be a successful [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Mander was able to use [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]], and [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]], but was also susceptible to the latter, following his apprentice's suggestion to lower his blade. Juxtaposed to this weakness, he was very knowledgeable about mind tricks and how to counter them; with [[Meditation of Emptiness|Empty Meditation]]. He wasn't the best at blast deflection, nor [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber dueling]] for that matter, being quickly disarmed by the inexperienced [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika the Hutt]]. Many even noted that he was not what they expected, when meeting him, further feeding his feelings of self-doubt. However, Mander was described as strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and after he defeated Mika, erased his mental hang-ups and felt his former apprentice's blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in his hand as an extension of his own.
